coordinateFrame: Runtime x/z maps to Blender x/-y before glTF export; metres

fire.design: modern low smokeless steel fire pit on a durable mineral-soil pocket; runtime owns flame, smoke, and light

communalZone.rule: The camp spur arrives through the open west gap. Five chairs define the social core; sleeping pitches remain beyond them on one quiet east/south arc.

siteLogic.stageRole: performance bowl remains central and unobstructed
siteLogic.campRole: separate east-rim camp pocket beyond the central audience meadow
siteLogic.audienceApproach: south and southwest of the stage
siteLogic.treeRelationship: the camp shelf occupies a dedicated woodland opening beyond two habitat screens rather than wrapping around a frame tree

sources.rule: If no existing pit is available and fires are permitted, select a site at least 15 feet from tents, shrubs, trees, and other flammables.
Clear litter, duff, and burnable material within a 10-foot circle; keep the fire small and water available.
Prefer an existing fire ring in an established campsite and place tents on durable, already impacted surfaces.
